### Make sure about:

- [x] This issue is not duplicated with any other open or closed issues.
- [x] I am using the latest version from the release.

### Describe the bug

When a user sends a particularly long piece of text from a Windows 11 computer to an Android phone, such as 105K of clipboard text, the app on the phone freezes. The only way to resolve it is to swipe the app away from the recent-apps screen.

### Expected behavior

Very long clipboard text should be sent normally. If this is technically impossible, the app could tell the user that it can only be saved as a file.

### Reproduction

First, copy a very long piece of text on the computer. Then click Send on the computer, click Clipboard, and click the device you want to send it to. The app on the receiving device will freeze.

### Device information

Dell Inspiron 3501, Windows 11 Pro
Xiaomi Redmi Note 10 Pro, MIUI 14, Android 13
Latest version of LocalSend
